Maya L: 20-min sprint: tighten launch copy vs managed endpoints + infra vendors. Need 6 SDR openers and 2 SE demo hooks.
Jules P: Copy targets: predictable p95, token-level cost breakdowns, and private deploy option.
Avery K: SDR openers should be <40 chars. Example brainstorm: "Stable p95, not noisy endpoints" or "See token-costs per feature".
Rohan S: For SEs: two demo scripts: 1) show KV cache hit with `cache.show_hits()`; 2) trigger fallback routing and show latency telemetry.
Maya L: Can someone A/B subject lines for the webinar? Want one econ-first and one reliability-first.
Jules P: I'll draft the 6 openers + two 1-liners for procurement questions. Posting by EOD.
Avery K: I'll run a 10-min SDR playtest Wed AM and share which openers land.
Maya L: Perfect. Drop any wild objections here and well slot into the battlecard. :rocket:
